title: Vibe-coded app to simulate engine and NPC behavior of controlled and self-driving RC cars
author: L_AIR
selftext:
The system is called Carrera Hybrid and trapecoids, an infrared sensor, and gyro allownthe cars to find rheir way (all firmware). The original app has limits such as connected cars, fixed NPC behavior, no NPC sound, no weather simulation etc. The vibe-coded app takes them away. I even have a light version of EngineSim included that lets me customize engine sounds and choose manual transmission amd the number of gears. Code is MIT licensed and on 

Github at https://luuke42.github.io/omegasim/

comments.author: OwoMeji
comments.body: How complicated is this for an absolute beginner/novice to learn how to do/replicate?

replies.author: L_AIR
replies.body:
You mean the app? If you have no programming experience, it will take you a few weeks to get them running. We are soon launching a Wiki that will help you though.

If you want cars to race, you just need the cars, a track, and open the app.
